nodes.name: APAF-API-Gateway
nodes.description: Central entry point for all external and internal API requests. Handles authentication, rate limiting, and routing to appropriate backend services.
responsibilities: Authenticate users (Public, Co-I's, SwRI Team)
Route requests to BFF or Domain Services
Enforce security policies (NFR-002, NFR-003)

nodes.name: Public-BFF
nodes.description: Backend for Frontend service tailored for Public Users. Aggregates data for public-facing web displays of current instrument performance.
responsibilities: Serve public web-based displays (FR-008)
Aggregate latest ASPERA-3 data for public view
Ensure no sensitive data is exposed to public

nodes.name: Science-Team-BFF
nodes.description: Backend for Frontend service tailored for ASPERA-3 Science Team and Co-Investigators. Provides access to science analysis displays and data retrieval interfaces.
responsibilities: Serve password-protected science analysis displays (FR-009)
Provide interface for IDFS data access software (FR-011)
Provide interface for science analysis software (FR-012)

nodes.name: Telemetry-Acquisition-Service
nodes.description: Responsible for acquiring ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry from ESOC on a daily basis. Handles initial data ingestion and validation.
responsibilities: Acquire telemetry from ESOC (FR-001)
Validate incoming telemetry data integrity (NFR-001)
Trigger processing workflows upon successful acquisition

nodes.name: Data-Processing-Service
nodes.description: Core domain service that processes raw telemetry into IDFS data sets and generates cleaned-up intermediate files. Handles calibration and validation logic.
responsibilities: Process ASPERA-3 science data into IDFS (FR-002)
Process engineering/ancillary data into IDFS (FR-003)
Generate cleaned-up telemetry intermediate files (FR-004)
Calibrate and validate data prior to PDS deposit (FR-014)

nodes.name: Data-Archival-Service
nodes.description: Manages the storage of raw telemetry, intermediate files, and IDFS data sets to the local SwRI archive. Ensures data availability for re-processing and analysis.
responsibilities: Store raw telemetry on local SwRI archive (FR-005)
Store IDFS data sets on local SwRI archive (FR-006)
Store intermediate cleaned-up telemetry files (FR-007)

nodes.name: PDS-Integration-Service
nodes.description: Handles the distribution of IDFS data and intermediate files to NASA PDS and Co-Investigators. Ensures PDS-compliant formatting and timely delivery.
responsibilities: Provide IDFS data to NASA PDS (FR-013)
Provide data to Co-I's within 24 hours (ASR-002)
Ensure PDS-compliant form for data (ASR-005)
Integrate science analysis software into PDS repository (FR-016)

nodes.name: APAF-Event-Bus
nodes.description: Message broker that facilitates asynchronous communication between services. Used for event sourcing to track state changes of data processing workflows.
responsibilities: Publish events for telemetry acquisition
Publish events for processing completion
Publish events for archival and distribution

nodes.name: APAF-Shared-Database
nodes.description: Shared monolithic database that retains ACID transactions. Stores metadata, processing status, and event logs for all domain services.
responsibilities: Store metadata for telemetry and IDFS data
Maintain strong consistency for PDS updates (ASR-003)
Support event sourcing logs

edges.justification: API Gateway routes public web-based display requests to Public-BFF
API Gateway routes password-protected science analysis requests to Science-Team-BFF
Telemetry-Acquisition-Service publishes telemetry acquisition events to APAF-Event-Bus
APAF-Event-Bus routes telemetry acquisition events to Data-Processing-Service
Data-Processing-Service sends processed data to Data-Archival-Service
Data-Processing-Service sends processed data to PDS-Integration-Service
Data-Archival-Service writes archived data to APAF-Shared-Database
PDS-Integration-Service writes PDS data to APAF-Shared-Database
Public-BFF reads public display data from APAF-Shared-Database
Science-Team-BFF reads science display data from APAF-Shared-Database
Data-Processing-Service publishes processing completion events to APAF-Event-Bus
Data-Archival-Service publishes archival completion events to APAF-Event-Bus
PDS-Integration-Service publishes distribution completion events to APAF-Event-Bus
